dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single prominent white horizontal band across the wing coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark wing body.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale edges visible along the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A single high-contrast white patch on the posterior neck, appearing roughly rectangular in geometry.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and sharp color transition between the dark crown region and the yellowish-green mantle, separated by a white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly saturated yellowish-green hue on the dorsal mantle and scapular region.
